n: Behavioral/Mental Health Initial Implementation of Needs Assessment
d: Department of Public Health & Environment (DDPHE) will initiate behavioral health programming based on the findings of the Mental Health & Substance Abuse Citywide Needs Assessment. Programs will focus on overdose prevention strategies and mental health support and assistance for youth and their families.
